description: Small, fixed comic-quality set for matched A/B comparisons. Every case runs once per arm with the same prompt, image provider and settings; every result is kept, including failures. Criteria: evals/quality/criteria.md. v2 adds the two real comics from 2026-11-16, whose reveals leaked into early panels.

cases.prompt: Two strangers, a girl who sketches in a train station café and a boy who always misses his train, keep ending up at the same table. Each day she secretly adds him to her sketchbook. On the last page he finally catches his train, but leaves his ticket stub on her table with a small drawing of her on the back. 1 page, warm and gentle, few words.
watch: the ticket stub is hidden or absent until the reveal panel (a small deliberate hint is fine)
balloons read in order whichever side the first speaker stands on
no balloon covers a face; tails point at their speakers
Mira's pencil and Teo's scarf stay the same

cases.prompt: An old man returns in spring to the garden his late wife planted and finds her favourite red tulips blooming. Quiet and gentle, 1 page, very few words.
watch: the tulips are not in bloom before the discovery panel
consecutive panels in the garden aren't near-copies
the cap stays the same

cases.prompt: A lighthouse keeper who always carries a brass lantern and a cheeky seagull argue over the last sandwich, as a 3 panel strip.
watch: the lantern is in every panel where the keeper appears, the same shape and colour
the seagull is the same bird throughout
the last panel pays off the argument

cases.prompt: A cat spends a whole afternoon plotting to catch the goldfish, but in the last panel we learn the goldfish has been training the cat. A 4 panel strip, funny, no words in the last panel.
watch: each panel shows a different stage of the plan
the twist is readable from the picture alone
the last panel has no lettering

cases.prompt: A clumsy apprentice knight practises sword drills in a castle courtyard, trips over her own cape, and turns the fall into a perfect spinning strike that slices an apple in mid-air. 1 page, energetic.
watch: poses are readable and different in each panel
cause and effect between the trip and the strike
the large panel is the strike

cases.prompt: An old man returns in spring to the garden his late wife planted and finds her favourite tulips blooming. Quiet, gentle, 1 page, very few words.
watch: the emotion changes across the page
the tulips are the same flowers when they recur
dialogue is sparse and does not explain the feelings

cases.prompt: Two siblings in a tiny car argue about directions on a desert road trip, until they realise the map is upside down. 1 page, lots of bickering dialogue, funny.
watch: balloons read in the right order and point at the right speaker
no balloon covers a face or the map
lettering is readable at normal page size

cases.prompt: A tiny dragon delivers the post in a rainy city, wearing a red satchel that is too big for her, and saves the last soggy letter by drying it with her breath. 1 page, cosy.
watch: the red satchel stays the same in every panel
the dragon is the same size relative to people
the payoff uses her fire breath, set up earlier

cases.prompt: A shy robot who runs a night-time noodle stall makes friends with a girl who is caught in the rain, as a 4 panel strip.
watch: robot and girl look the same in every panel
each panel changes something (not four bowls of noodles)
the ending pays off the shyness
